alternative_fix_sites: relay/limiter.py::Limiter.reserve (save each bucket only before its first take, e.g. `if key not in saved`, or snapshot every involved bucket before the loop, or give back exactly the units taken)
notes: The all-or-nothing reservation saves a bucket's state before every take instead of only before the first take of that key, so the rollback restores the state after the last successful take of the key: every earlier take of a repeated key stays charged. Needs a rejected batch (max wait exceeded) in which a key appears at least twice before or at the rejected job; batches whose keys appear once each, and single submissions, roll back correctly (public test). Symptoms: fewer tokens, later ready times and spurious RateLimited for later submissions, two modules away from the defect. Restoring buckets in Dispatcher.submit_batch instead passes the dispatcher and script probes but fails the direct Limiter.reserve probe, whose docstring and the README promise the guarantee.
